name: Line follower
summary: A two-wheel robot that follows a black tape line on white paper.

safety.text: The motors start as soon as power is applied. Lift the wheels off the table until the calibration step.

steps.title: Mount the sensors
steps.body: Fix the pairs 12 mm above the paper, one either side of the line.

steps.title: Wire the motor driver
steps.body: Connect the PWM inputs to GPIO 18 and 19. Share the ground with the Pi.

steps.title: Load the program
steps.body: Copy the program onto the image and run it from the shell.

steps.title: Calibrate
steps.body: Hold it over white paper, press Enter, then over the black line.
